overall_goal: Bake the pizza in the pizza oven, rotating it halfway through for even cooking

goals.description: Set up and plug in the pizza oven
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the pizza oven, positions it on the counter, and plugs it into the power socket.

goals.description: Check the pizza oven temperature and prepare it for baking
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly checks the oven's temperature by adjusting the knobs and feeling the heat inside before leaving the lid open to insert the pizza.

goals.description: Transfer the pizza into the oven and start the cooking timer
goals.rationale: The person slides the pizza off the peel onto the oven stone, closes the lid, and sets the timer to begin cooking.

goals.description: Rotate the pizza and absorb excess moisture during cooking
goals.rationale: The person uses spatulas to turn the pizza for even cooking and uses kitchen roll to dab away water released by the mozzarella.
